What you work through

4 objectives · 4 sections · 33 min

  1. 01
    Two ways of saying itTell everyday affection from a direct romantic declaration
    8 min
  2. 02
    Choosing by addressee and settingChoose the polite expression for a first confession
    10 min
  3. 03
    A new contextRecall the intimate declaration in a new context
    8 min
  4. 04
    A close friend in publicChoose the register for a close friend in public
    7 min

What this course will not teach

  • Kanji beyond the lines each section writes out; every Japanese line carries romaji and an English meaning.
  • Native-speaker pronunciation: the bundled clip is synthetic speech, and the pack says so.
  • Listening or speaking assessment: no listening or pronunciation evidence is graded here.

From the creator

Written as the sample L0 classroom: four lines, three addressees, one decision. Original teaching text; the only bundled media are a synthetic narration clip and a deterministic relationship map.

Parent demo: measuring ingredients together

Read a measuring jug and double a quantity, with a parent guiding and the answers kept off the learner page.

Validated
For parentsAge 8-10 · parent-led · en-US · 10 min · v1.0.0

Validated on this page means two machine checks: every file matches its manifest hash, and the automated pack checks passed. It is not a human review and not a claim that the teaching is right.

What you work through

2 objectives · 2 sections · 10 min

  1. 01
    Task 1 — read the jugRead the marks on a measuring jug
    5 min
  2. 02
    Task 2 — double the recipeDouble a recipe quantity and explain the operation
    5 min

What this course will not teach

  • Fractions, unit conversion or reading a scale finer than the 50 ml marks.
  • Any hazard: the pack uses water and a jug, with no heat, sharp tools or chemicals.
  • A child-facing chat: this recipe is parent-led, and the parent records what happened.

From the creator

Prepared for a parent to run, not for a child talking to a tutor. The learner page carries the two tasks; the answer guide is a separate file the manifest declares by role.
